title: Training Note: Sign-Up Usage Bonus on Residential Electricity Supply
content:
Training note, Residential Electricity Supply sign-up credits.

**Q. How is the sign-up usage bonus decided?**
A. The kWh of all of the agreement's energy charge lines are added up and divided by the completed cycles; at 1,200 kWh per cycle or more the high sign-up usage bonus of 10.00 USD is added, from 800 up to but not including 1,200 kWh the mid sign-up usage bonus of 5.00 USD is added, and below 800 kWh nothing is added.

**Q. What enters the two figures?**
A. The kWh include every energy charge line on the agreement: all-hours, on-peak and off-peak alike. The completed cycles are the agreement's billing cycles that carry an on-peak or an all-hours energy charge line. An agreement with no completed cycles adds nothing.

| kWh per completed cycle | Sign-up usage bonus |
|---|---|
| 1,200 or more | 10.00 USD |
| 800 up to but not including 1,200 | 5.00 USD |
| below 800 | nothing |

**Q. A hypothetical case?**
A. A Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 agreement with 4 completed cycles has on-peak lines totalling 2,600 kWh and off-peak lines totalling 2,300 kWh: 4,900 kWh over 4 cycles is 1,225 kWh per cycle, which adds 10.00 USD.
